scripts.dev:server: cd server && NODE_ENV=development npx tsx watch index.ts
scripts.start: cd server && NODE_ENV=production npx tsx index.ts
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build && bash desktop/build-scripts/prepare-resources.sh && concurrently --kill-others "cd server && CLAW_DESKTOP=1 NODE_ENV=production npx tsx index.ts" "cd desktop && pnpm tauri dev"
scripts.desktop:build: bash desktop/build-scripts/download-node.sh && npm run build && bash desktop/build-scripts/prepare-resources.sh && cd desktop && pnpm tauri build
